# Credits

PrivacyNotes is shaped by the people who report bugs and ask for features in [our issues](https://github.com/LifetimeLabsHQ/PrivacyNotes.app/issues). 119 people have opened an issue so far, and 562 reports are now fixed or built. Thank you.

"Shipped" counts the bug reports and feature requests of a person that we closed as done. The list updates every day. To leave the list, say so in any issue.
